column1: # Country -> region, for the per-run panel's column grouping. AUTHORED, and a judgement.
# Countries are too fine a grain: 41 of them across a 7-inch grid left 18 too narrow to name,
# and the geographic signal is not national anyway. Septoria tritici blotch is a maritime
# western European disease, stem rust an East African and Southern Cone one; those are the
# NINE regions, deliberately coarse. Europe splits only east/west: a finer cut (northwest /
# central / southeast / Mediterranean) was tried and made four thin blocks out of one clear
# contrast. Turkey, Israel and Morocco are NOT Europe and sit in North Africa and West Asia.
# Pakistan and Bhutan join East Asia as one Asia block rather than carrying 7 runs alone.
# `region_order` is not used: the panel orders regions west to east by the mean longitude of
# their own runs. A country here with no runs costs nothing. A country in the data and NOT
# here is a hard error, never a silent "Other".
